messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike detected for org 'np-442' (Northport Labs) in prod-us-west-1. 5m QPS ~12k (norm ~800). /generate high contributor. Error rate creeping up. Paging on-call.

maya_oncall: Picking this up — can someone paste recent deploys and dashboards?

jamal_sre: No deploys in the last 2h. Dashboards: https://console.redwood-inference/prod-us-west-1/org/np-442/metrics — QPS and latency charts show sudden surge.

elena_eng: Seeing lots of short, concurrent requests causing KV cache churn. Patterns look like retry loops from the client. Almost all hitting model v3-7B.

maya_oncall: Plan: 1) apply emergency per-org sustained QPS cap 2) set a tight burst window for them 3) route non-priority /generate to fallback variant. I'll run the changes and post commands here.

ops-tilly: Agreed. Also loop in the account manager so customer knows. @account-zoe can you ping them?

account-zoe: DM'ed Northport ops. Told them we'll apply short-term protections and asked them to check for retry logic. They acknowledged.

maya_oncall: Executing adjustments. Commands posted below:
```
# emergency org limits: sustained 60 qps, burst 5k for 2h
redwoodctl org-adjust --org np-442 --sustained-qps 60 --burst 5000 --expiry 2h --note "emergency bridge for retry flood"
# route non-priority /generate to CPU fallback to reduce GPU pressure
redwoodctl route-update --org np-442 --path /generate --fallback-model v3-7B-cpu-fallback --priority 0 --note "reduce GPU tail latency for noncritical"
```

incident-bot: Commands accepted. change_id=ch_20260317_np442_01. Applied in prod-us-west-1.

jamal_sre: Traffic from np-442 dropped to ~1.2k QPS within 90s. Cluster tail latencies falling. Other orgs' error rates improving.

elena_eng: Also toggled off their enrichment route to cut KV churn: `feature-flag disable np-442 enrichment-multimodal` (30m).

ops-tilly: AM updated. Customer says they found runaway retries and will deploy a fix in ~45m. Asked for monitoring window.

maya_oncall: Leaving automatic expiry at 2h. Created incident record INC-2026-032. I'll add rollback automation if expiry not extended.

jamal_sre: Setting watch: alert at change expiry +15m to ensure rollback occurred.

account-zoe: Customer: "Thanks, that's reduced our errors. Deploying fix now." :white_check_mark:

maya_oncall: If metrics stay green for 30m we'll move to monitoring. Please capture exact timeline for postmortem.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ch_20260317_np442_01 will auto-expire in 1h 59m 40s unless extended. Expiry alert scheduled.

(45m later)

account-zoe: Customer reports fix deployed at 1767781200 and initial tests OK. They request caps be lifted when safe.

maya_oncall: Lifting now. Command:
```
redwoodctl org-adjust --org np-442 --revert ch_20260317_np442_01 --note "customer fix validated"
```

incident-bot: Revert accepted. ch_20260317_np442_01 reverted at 1767781345.

jamal_sre: Observing QPS stabilize ~850. Latency and errors back to baseline. Marking INC-2026-032 as resolved (monitoring).

maya_oncall: Short RCA notes: root cause likely client retry loop targeting /generate with tiny prompts, causing KV churn on v3-7B. Effective mitigations: per-org sustained QPS cap, bounded burst, route noncritical to CPU fallback, disable enrichment, and AM outreach. Action items: elena -> prepare rollback/playbook and test automated caps; jamal -> confirm expiry watches and build alert; zoe -> confirm final customer postmortem.

ops-tilly: Adding follow-up to runbook for similar patterns and verify org-level cap defaults.

maya_oncall: Closing active page. Thanks all. :coffee:
